newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daewoo wins $280 mln deals for four ships.
newsitem.headline: Daewoo wins $280 mln deals for four ships.

text.p: Daewoo Heavy Industries Co, a unit of South Korea's Daewoo Group, said on Wednesday it had won two European orders totalling $280 million to build four crude carriers.
Daewoo said in a statement one of the orders, to build two 300,000 gross-tonne carriers, was from Niarchos Group of Greece
The other, to build two 160,000-tonne crude carriers, was received from Sweden's ICB Shipping AB, it said.
All four carriers are scheduled to be delivered in the second half of 1998, the statement added.
